fact: Tanzania's National Audit Office reports that the Tanzania Meteorological Authority faced challenges in processing data from satellites and global observation centres because these sources lacked adequate localization.
The DMI peer review for SOFF says the Tanzania Meteorological Authority relies on EUMETSAT satellite imagery and radars, which are particularly beneficial for nowcasting, to deliver its forecasts.
The DMI peer review says the Tanzania Meteorological Authority holds ISO 9001:2015 certification for its aeronautical meteorological services only, successfully re-audited in January 2024.
